name: Maximal Independent Set
problem_statement: Find one independent vertex set that cannot be enlarged by adding any remaining vertex.

normalization: Remove self-loops and collapse parallel edges to form a simple undirected graph.

solution_semantics.objective: Return an inclusion-maximal independent set; larger size is an optional heuristic quality metric.
solution_semantics.exactness: Independence and maximality are exact requirements; maximum cardinality is not required.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Every excluded vertex has at least one selected neighbor.
edge_cases: Every isolated vertex must be selected.
An empty graph has the empty independent set.

correctness: Every excluded vertex has at least one selected neighbor.
